scope: Independent read-only source/visual review of the frozen native Cards safe-area patch. No new Android or full master approval.
review: Godot4.6.3 exact-source API comparison: public AndroidRuntime.getActivity and createRunnableFromGodotCallable, JavaObject superclass traversal, Rect.Rect constructor, public Field.getInt and JavaClassWrapper.get_exception are used correctly. Non-JavaObject plugin calls do not consume stale exception status.

Only Android View/Insets reads execute on the Android UI thread. The result dictionary is delivered through Callable.call_deferred before scene or Control state changes; no window flag, immersive policy or system-bar setter is used.
Actual decor size, SurfaceView size and descendant bounds accompany systemBars|displayCutout. Already-applied view padding is subtracted before safe UI offsets, avoiding a second inset.
Null/unattached Java observations and exceptions remain unavailable observations and are retried. Controls remain hidden until the current Godot window has an accepted measurement.

Diagnostic file is invalidated on layout/hand/selection/accepted pending action and deleted on exit or lost authority. Publication waits two frames, no pending action, completed hand tweens and zero camera focus; discard animation lasts0.4s while changed-top focus returns over more than1s.
Atomic write/rename and monotonic per-scene sequence preserve the raw settled snapshot. Diagnostic file is separate from all gameplay saves; scene token and public state fields are included.

Portrait playing/paused and landscape screenshots were independently opened. Pause/Back/header are inside the measured safe region; modal text/resume action and footer remain visible. These are local real X11 frames with explicit platform-inset fixtures, not Android captures.
Host projector independently calculates card polygons and compares Godot readbacks. Actual supplied quads are never used as sampling coordinates.
limitations: Adapter JNI stubs and software-renderer fixtures are not evidence of an actual installed Android35/37 APK using these new files.
Physical Fold7 performance, temperature, touch latency and sixty FPS remain unmeasured.
Exact Android View/Insets observations must be captured and checked with the current screenshot, token, revision and state during the next strict runtime probe.
